# `oaap files`

the byte store of RFC-0034 (Stufe 1, local).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap files [--tenant TENANT] [--sha256 SHA256]
                  {status,put,get,verify} [target]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `target` | a path for 'put', a hash for 'get' |
| `--tenant TENANT` | whose store — default: this node's own |
| `--sha256 SHA256` | put: the hash the caller believes it is storing; a mismatch refuses |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `status` | yes |
| `put` | yes |
| `get` | yes |
| `verify` | yes |
